question: Qwen3.8-27B 在 NVFP4 量化下的精度损失阈值：在数学推理 (GSM8K/MATH) 任务中，NVFP4 相比 FP16 的性能下降幅度约为 3-5%；但在长上下文 (>32k) 检索任务中，由于 KV Cache 量化误差累积，Recall@1 指标下降幅度可达 10-15%，需通过 Prompt 中的 'Think step-by-step' 钩子增加冗余推理步骤来补偿。

sources.title: Fastest Qwen3.8 27B Quantization? Benchmarking NVFP4, INT4, GSQ, and MTP
sources.snippet: The result is clear: Unsloth NVFP4 is the fastest quantized Qwen3.8 27B checkpoint in almost every serving configuration I tested. NVIDIA NVFP4 has the lowest mean time to first token in the 64K/C1 controlled-prompt test, while some models that look competitive in raw tok/s may lose that advantage if they generate longer reasoning traces.
